metadata.notes: Lift-piste 'served_by' edges are derived by proximity: a piste endpoint (start or end) within match_radius_m of a lift base or top station is considered served by that lift. This is a spatial heuristic, not an explicit OSM relation, so a small number of edges may be spurious or missing near complex junctions. resort_nearest is assigned by nearest resort center distance and is informational only (lifts/pistes near resort boundaries may be shared between resorts).
